title: A person picked in the filter who is then turned off drops out of the filter
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work order.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B, with one approved line, line 1, holding a labor entry for staff member A, so staff member A has work that must not move.
  • Have Settings, Staff open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Technician filter.
  2. Pick staff member A in the Technician filter.
  3. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  4. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  5. Switch Technician off.
  6. Click Save & Close.
  7. Click Save in the warning.
  8. Switch to the Board View tab.
  9. Reload the Board View page.
  10. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The filter offers staff member A.

Step 2:

  • The Technician filter is on, set to staff member A.

Step 3:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 4:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 5:

  • Technician is off.

Step 6:

  • The "Turn Off Technician" warning shows, because staff member A is on line 1.

Step 7:

  • The warning and the window close.
  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 8:

  • Board View shows, not reloaded.

Step 9:

  • Staff member A is no longer picked in the Technician filter, as if never picked, and is no longer offered there.
  • Work order 1's card is still in staff member B's column: it did not move.

Step 10:

  • Staff member B is still the lead and line 1 still shows staff member A's labor entry.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S3-N1: “A person with Technician off, or with Time Clock off, gets no Board View column, no Tech View group, and is not offered in the Technician filter or any technician dropdown, unless S3-E1 or S3-E2 applies. A person already picked in the Technician filter who is no longer offered (Technician turned off, or a person from another location) is dropped from the filter the next time the board loads, as if never picked. Their work orders do not move.”
  • S3-R3: “The Technician filter on Work Orders offers the same people the board gives a column or group to.”
  • S2-R5: “Saving with Technician off unassigns nothing. Every lead and labor line stays as it was (Story 3, S3-R7 and S3-R8).”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 4 (question 4): “4. (b) The filter drops them, as if they had never been picked. This is the same as what happens today to someone from another location or a deleted staff member. Their work orders don't move. I'll add this to S3-N1.”
